instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Turn what was gathered about a creator or a topic (video words, page text) into the instruction the person's AI writes a profile from", and give it subject_ref; instruction (What the writer is to look for, in the person's words).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:write-a-profile-request and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give subject_ref (who or what is profiled), instruction (the person's own words on what to look for; they come before the material) and either material (one text) or evidence ([{ id, text }], for example one video's words each).
